prompt:
Produce up to 4 distinct, useful design or engineering actions for the task below. Explore materially different mechanisms, including non-obvious alternatives. Respect every constraint. Give executable changes in the target domain, with an implementation step and a falsifiable check. Do not claim unmeasured gains, invent supporting facts, or rename the same action several ways. State actions in the user's terms; omit donor names and analogy explanations from the answer. Fewer actions, including none, are acceptable when no additional valid action remains. Keep each action compact: aim for 60–80 words TOTAL across its five fields, never more than 110. Suggested field budgets: action 8 words, mechanism 16, implementation 22, check 20, risk 10. The 110-word maximum applies to the SUM of all five values, not to each field.

Task:
{
  "title": "Asset search that preserves intentional variants",
  "brief": "A design team has 12,000 image assets, including exact duplicates, crops, annotated versions, and distinct licensed copies. Search results are cluttered, but deleting similar-looking files could destroy useful work.",
  "constraints": [
    "File hashes, dimensions, creator IDs, license records, and folder paths are available.",
    "No automatic file deletion or license substitution.",
    "People can record explicit relationships between versions.",
    "The first search result page must load in under one second from the existing index."
  ],
  "success_criteria": [
    "Exact duplicates can be condensed without hiding meaningful variants.",
    "A user can recover which licensed file a project used.",
    "Test identical pixels with different license records and different crops of one original."
  ],
  "non_goals": [
    "Training an image model or redesigning storage infrastructure."
  ]
}
Optional outside cue:
Relation: Several partial sequences overlap. Shared patterns allow the sequences to be aligned so a missing or extra local observation can be detected instead of treating every local position as a complete clock. Confidence comes from agreement over a distinctive pattern, not one matching element.
Boundary: Alignment needs enough comparable shared structure. Repeated patterns, unrelated local conditions, or insufficient overlap can leave multiple plausible alignments; do not force a unique match.
Treat the relation as an optional prompt for exploration. Transfer useful relationships, not surface nouns. The donor is not evidence that a target intervention will work. Ignore the cue if it cannot support a valid move.

Return JSON only: {"actions":[{"action":"...","mechanism":"...","implementation":"...","check":"...","risk":"..."}],"abstention_reason":""}. Use abstention_reason only to explain an empty action list. No tools or additional research.
